name: Inter Stable Token
oneLiner: IST was Agoric's Inter Protocol stable token, formerly minted against vault collateral and PSM deposits before governance sunset the protocol in 2025.
collateral: Overcollateralized crypto vaults on Agoric accepting IBC-bridged ATOM and stATOM, plus a Parity Stability Module (PSM) that mints IST 1:1 against approved stablecoins (USDC, USDT, DAI) bridged from Ethereum via IBC
pegMechanism: IST was minted through Inter Protocol vaults and PSM facilities. Agoric governance approved a wind-down in mid-2025, disabled new minting, and completed the sunset process on June 26, 2025.

notices.title: DefiLlama vs CoinGecko supply mismatch
notices.message: DefiLlama (llamaId 135) now includes Agoric-native and Osmosis IST rows, but still differs from CoinGecko's cross-chain supply treatment. Pharos uses the DefiLlama series as the primary feed; reserve dependency scoring keeps the mixed USDC/USDT/DAI PSM slice unlinked until the live source exposes stablecoin-level weights.

obituary.obituary: Agoric governance approved Inter Protocol's wind-down in mid-2025, disabled new IST minting, and completed the sunset process on June 26, 2025. Pharos keeps IST as a frozen archive because the former vault and PSM dollar stablecoin no longer operates as an active mintable protocol asset.
